name: Catoni⊓Quad with Soft-01 Blend
tagline: Joint Catoni-λ + quadratic bounds (take min) on a multi-sample bounded NLL blended with a temperature-soft 0/1 surrogate.

key_hyperparams.name: soft-01 temperature T
key_hyperparams.role: sharpness of softmax used as 0/1 surrogate

key_hyperparams.name: α (soft-01 blend)
key_hyperparams.role: weight of soft-01 vs bounded NLL

key_hyperparams.name: λ init
key_hyperparams.role: Catoni λ start, jointly optimised by SGD

init_recovers: Quadratic bound on bounded NLL when α=0 and Catoni term is dominated.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to mcallester/catoni/quadratic individually, this picks the elementwise minimum of Catoni-λ and Quadratic on a *blended* surrogate combining bounded-NLL (3-sample MC averaged) and a temperature-scaled soft 0/1 loss; certificate uses PAC-Bayes-kl inversion on the 0/1 risk.

name: Adaptive-Curvature Bound
tagline: McAllester sqrt-KL term scaled by (1 + β·empirical_risk) where β is a learned non-negative curvature parameter.

key_hyperparams.name: β (curvature)
key_hyperparams.role: scales sqrt-KL term by empirical risk

diff_from_baseline: Replaces McAllester's additive sqrt-KL with a multiplicatively boosted version (1 + β·R̂) and meta-trains β jointly with the posterior — neither McAllester, Catoni nor Quadratic introduce a curvature scalar; certificate is still PAC-Bayes-kl inversion on 0/1 risk.

name: Differentiable inv-KL on Ensemble NLL
tagline: Differentiable Seeger-Langford bound (bisection forward + analytic backward) trained on a multi-sample ensemble bounded NLL.

key_hyperparams.name: learning_rate (override)
key_hyperparams.role: raised because inv-KL gradients are small

init_recovers: Standard PAC-Bayes-kl bound (Seeger-Langford) on the bounded ensemble NLL.
diff_from_baseline: Trains the posterior directly through the *tightest* PAC-Bayes-kl (Seeger-Langford) bound by implementing a differentiable inverse-binary-KL (bisection + analytic gradient) and feeding it an ensemble bounded NLL; baselines train through the looser McAllester / Catoni / Quadratic surrogates.

name: Catoni+Quad Mixture on Ensemble Surrogate
tagline: Convex blend of Catoni-λ and Quadratic bounds on an ensemble bounded-NLL plus a Jensen-gap stability regulariser.

key_hyperparams.name: λ init
key_hyperparams.role: Catoni λ jointly optimised by SGD

init_recovers: Pure Catoni at μ=0; pure Quadratic at μ=1.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the pure Catoni or Quadratic baselines, replaces the single-sample bounded NLL with an ensemble Jensen surrogate, trains λ jointly, and convex-combines Catoni and Quadratic with mix μ that depends on the per-instance complexity term c — also adds a 0.2·Jensen-gap stability penalty.

name: Closed-Form-λ Catoni + KL Budget
tagline: Catoni bound where λ is set analytically per call to its optimal value, plus a soft KL-budget penalty on training loss.

key_hyperparams.name: λ rule
key_hyperparams.role: no learnable λ, set per call

init_recovers: Vanilla Catoni baseline at the analytical λ when KL ≤ budget (penalty = 0).
diff_from_baseline: Replaces Catoni's learnable λ (jointly SGD-trained) with a per-call closed-form optimum λ⋆ = (−1+√(1+4k))/(2k), uses a 2-sample MC bounded-NLL surrogate, and adds a soft hinge penalty when KL exceeds 1e-4·n — the named Catoni baseline learns λ; McAllester/Quadratic don't expose λ at all.
